messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — follow-up from the telecom POC (AcmeTel). They want BYOK with threshold-style key splitting (customer wants 2-of-3 shares), offline key ceremony support, and an outline of billing impact for Dedicated vs Private. Can we confirm what we can offer and any blockers?

sam_solutions: Quick summary: hosted API = wrapped CEKs via customer KMS (no built-in threshold splitting). Private/on-prem can integrate with customer HSMs that support share/threshold workflows but will need ops+SOW. Looping in @kevin_engineering and @anya_security. :mag:

kevin_engineering: Correct — hosted doesn't provide native threshold HSM. For Private we can deploy customer-provided HSMs (or FIPS-validated appliances) in their network and coordinate ceremonies, but the ceremony orchestration is typically customer-owned or added as T&M. We store only wrapped KEKs; runtime uses envelope encryption.

kevin_engineering: Example config snippet we send to ops (for reference):
```
crypto:
  key_source: external_kms
  wrap_algo: rsa-oaep-256
  rotation_window_days: 90
  allow_zero_downtime_rotation: true
```

maria_sales: They specifically asked: 1) can rotation be automated with zero-downtime? 2) can we prove the primary key never exists in single HSM? 3) what are audit/logging options they can consume?

kevin_engineering: 1) We expose a rotation API for KEKs and support staged rewraps; with rolling rewrap + dual-KEK compatibility clients see no downtime in normal traffic patterns. Caveat: extremely warm KV caches may temporarily see cold hits — we document cache-warmup.

kevin_engineering: 2) We don't have native threshold-splitting primitives in hosted; for Private you can use HSM vendors (nCipher/Thales/Yubico combos) that provide key-splitting. Our role is to accept wrapped keys and enforce access controls so the plaintext master never leaves the HSM cluster. We can add an explicit compliance statement in the SOW on split-key guarantees when customer supplies the HSM.

anya_security: 3) Audit/logging: we can stream key usage logs to customer's SIEM (syslog, CloudWatch, or Splunk). For Private we can also expose HSM audit trails directly if customer approves. Hosted customers get detailed usage events (key-wrap / unwrap) with redacted identifiers. We support HSMs that are FIPS 140-2/3 validated for Private deployments.

anya_security: Also note: for audit/compliance they will want KMS role separation, MFA for key ceremonies, and immutable audit retention. We'll include recommended controls in the security annex. Link to docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/kms-and-hsm (internal).

maria_sales: Pricing: they expect line-items for HSM instances, dedicated ops for ceremony, and ongoing monitoring fees. Is that how we usually quote?

sam_solutions: Yes — typical breakdown: platform license (Private), HSM hosting or customer-supplied hardware, one-time key-ceremony engineering + runbook (T&M), and monthly monitoring + audit export. I'll draft an estimate. cc @kevin_engineering to confirm estimated engineer hours (ceremony + integration).

kevin_engineering: Estimate: 40-80 engineer hours for initial ceremony + integration and 8-16 hours/month for monitoring & patchops depending on scope. If customer supplies HSM and has internal ops, number drops significantly.

deploy-bot: deployment note: private-poc-acmetel scheduled for 2024-08-14T10:00Z (ops booked).

maria_sales: They also asked about key rotation cadence (they want 30-day rotation) — do we have any hard limits or perf impacts?

kevin_engineering: No hard limits; 30-day rotation is supported but increases ops and log volume. We recommend 60-90 days for KEKs and more frequent CEK rotation if they require it. We'll add guidance in SOW about expected CPU/GPU impact during rewrap windows.

anya_security: Security annex items I'll add: evidence of FIPS validation for selected HSM, key import/export procedures, split-key policy language, retention & access log export, and requirement checklist for customer-side roles.

sam_solutions: Next steps: 1) schedule a technical Q&A with AcmeTel and our trio (maria/sam/kevin/anya) 2) draft SOW bullets + pricing estimate 3) security annex draft 4) confirm whether customer will supply HSM or wants us to host. Can we do the call Thursday 13:00 PT? :calendar:

maria_sales: Thursday 13:00 PT works for them. I'll send invite and attach this thread. Please mark any open questions you want me to surface.

kevin_engineering: I'll add tech SOW bullets in a doc and share before the call (low-risk, rotation API details, cache warmup notes).

anya_security: I'll add the security annex and sample checklist for the ceremony.

sam_solutions: I'll produce a preliminary cost breakdown by EOD tomorrow.

maria_sales: Awesome — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
